plan.title: SRC-NEG-006 Counter Offer Acceptance During Evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen with Vendor A's normal bid.
Send the counter offer for Vendor A's bid at the requested price with the required remark.
Verify the Responses grid marks the counter offer as initiated for Vendor A.
Have Vendor A accept the pending counter offer in the vendor portal.
Return to the buyer session to inspect the accepted counter offer and resulting values.
Verify the buyer's Responses grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as accepted.
Verify the counter-offer panel counts the accepted offer.
Verify the buyer's Responses view displays the accepted current price of 90.
Open Master QCS and verify Vendor A remains represented after acceptance.
Verify Master QCS uses the accepted counter price of 90.
Verify the awarded-value basis is 90 multiplied by the quantity of 10.
Verify the Master QCS line amount and total arithmetic.
